lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Every Sunday morning, it starts the same way: my mom's voice, from downstairs.
lines.spoken: Every Sunday morning, it starts the same way: my mom's voice, from downstairs.
lines.subtitle: Every Sunday morning, it starts the same way: my mom's voice, from downstairs.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Whatever the week was, we come down.
lines.spoken: Whatever the week was, we come down.
lines.subtitle: Whatever the week was, we come down.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Downstairs, the coffee has already begun.
lines.spoken: Downstairs, the coffee has already begun.
lines.subtitle: Downstairs, the coffee has already begun.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The beans crackle in the pan, and the smell climbs the stairs before we do.
lines.spoken: The beans crackle in the pan, and the smell climbs the stairs before we do.
lines.subtitle: The beans crackle in the pan, and the smell climbs the stairs before we do.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Etan smoke curls through the room. Nobody is in a hurry.
lines.spoken: ዕጣን smoke curls through the room. Nobody is in a hurry.
lines.subtitle: Etan smoke curls through the room. Nobody is in a hurry.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There's popcorn, sometimes kolo, and a lot of noise.
lines.spoken: There's popcorn, sometimes ቆሎ, and a lot of noise.
lines.subtitle: There's popcorn, sometimes kolo, and a lot of noise.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: With the first cup, abol, we catch up on the week: school, tests, work.
lines.spoken: With the first cup, አቦል, we catch up on the week: school, tests, work.
lines.subtitle: With the first cup, abol, we catch up on the week: school, tests, work.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: With the second, tona, it's university applications, and everyone has an opinion.
lines.spoken: With the second, ቶና, it's university applications, and everyone has an opinion.
lines.subtitle: With the second, tona, it's university applications, and everyone has an opinion.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The third cup is bereka, the blessing. The room gets quieter.
lines.spoken: The third cup is በረካ, the blessing. The room gets quieter.
lines.subtitle: The third cup is bereka, the blessing. The room gets quieter.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The coffee was never really the point.
lines.spoken: The coffee was never really the point.
lines.subtitle: The coffee was never really the point.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It's the few hours every week we're all in the same room. Next Sunday, she'll call again, and we'll come down.
lines.spoken: It's the few hours every week we're all in the same room. Next Sunday, she'll call again, and we'll come down.
lines.subtitle: It's the few hours every week we're all in the same room. Next Sunday, she'll call again, and we'll come down.
